verses.ar:
اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ
مَا لَنَا مَوْلًى سِوَى اللّٰهِ
كُلَّمَا نَادَيْتُ يَا هُو
قَالَ يَا عَبْدِي أَنَا اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
Allāhu Allāhu Allāhu Allāh
Mā lanā mawlan siwa-llāh
Kullamā nādaytu yā Hū
Qāla yā ʿabdī ana-llāh
verses.en: Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah — we have no master but Allah. Whenever I cry out, 'O He,' He answers: 'O My servant, I am Allah.'

verses.ar:
فِي رَبِيعٍ أَطْلَعَ اللّٰهُ
وَأَتَى النَّصْرُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ
يَا لَهُ شَهْرٌ عَظِيمُ
وَشَرِيفٌ كَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
Fī Rabīʿin aṭlaʿa-llāh
Wa atā-n-naṣru mina-llāh
Yā lahu shahrun ʿaẓīmu
Wa sharīfun karrama-llāh
verses.en: In Rabi' al-Awwal Allah caused the dawn to break, and victory came from Allah — what a magnificent month, ennobled by Allah's own generosity.

verses.ar:
فِيهِ جَمْعًا قَدْ فَرِحْنَا
وَبِنَيْلِ الْقَصْدِ فُزْنَا
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ طِبْنَا
وَعَلَيْنَا أَنْعَمَ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
Fīhi jamʿan qad fariḥnā
Wa bi-nayli-l-qaṣdi fuznā
Yā Rasūla-llāhi ṭibnā
Wa ʿalaynā anʿama-llāh
verses.en: In it we have all rejoiced together, and in attaining our purpose we have triumphed; O Messenger of Allah, we have found our joy, and Allah has showered us with His favour.

verses.ar:
ظَهَرَ الدِّينُ الْمُؤَيَّدْ
بِظُهُورِ الْهَادِي أَحْمَدْ
يَا هَنَاءً بِمُحَمَّدْ
ذَلِكَ الْفَضْلُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ
verses.tr:
Ẓahara-d-dīnu-l-muʾayyad
bi-ẓuhūri-l-Hādī Aḥmad
Yā hanā'an bi-Muḥammad
Dhālika-l-faḍlu mina-llāh
verses.en: The upheld religion has appeared with the appearance of the Guide, Ahmad — what joy in Muhammad! That is the bounty of Allah.

verses.ar:
ثَانِيَ عَشَرَ فِي رَبِيعِ
كَانَ مِيلَادُ الشَّفِيعِ
صَاحِبُ الْقَدْرِ الرَّفِيعِ
مَنْ لَهُ قَدْ أَيَّدَ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
Thāniya ʿashara fī Rabīʿi
kāna mīlādu-sh-Shafīʿi
Ṣāḥibu-l-qadri-r-rafīʿi
Man lahu qad ayyada-llāh
verses.en: On the twelfth of Rabi' al-Awwal was the birth of the Intercessor, possessor of exalted rank — the one whom Allah Himself has strengthened.

verses.ar:
يَوْمَ مِيلَادِ التِّهَامِي
خَاتَمِ الرُّسْلِ الْكِرَامِ
زُخْرِفَتْ دَارُ السَّلَامِ
وَأَتَى النَّصْرُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ
verses.tr:
Yawma mīlādi-t-Tihāmī
khātami-r-rusuli-l-kirāmi
Zukhrifat dāru-s-salāmi
wa atā-n-naṣru mina-llāh
verses.en: On the day of the birth of the one from Tihamah, seal of the noble messengers, the Abode of Peace was adorned, and victory came from Allah.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, send peace and blessings upon him and his family.
